pages.text: Unbound, finds the nearest damaged item on an equipment pedestal or Botania Tiny Potato's six display slots within 8 blocks. Optionally bind one pedestal with the wand. Restores 1 durability for 50 mana, preserving enchantments/NBT. A full, empty or invalid explicit binding never falls back or charges. Crafting-repair veto does not block mana restoration.
